test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 10 March, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many terms of the series -9, -6, -3, ..... must be taken so that the sum of all the terms is 45?
solution:
**Given:**

Series -9, -6, -3, .....

Number of terms = 45

**Concept Used:**

Sum of series = n/2[2a + (n - 1)d]

where, n = number of terms

a = first term

d = common difference

**Calculation:**

Series -9, -6, -3, .....

Sum = 45

a = -9

d = -6 - (-9) = 3

Sum of series = n/2[2a + (n - 1)d]

45 = n/2 [2 × (-9) + (n - 1)(3)]

45 = n/2 [-18 + 3n - 3]

15 = n/2 [-6 + n - 1]

30 = -7n + n² 

n2 - 7n - 30 = 0

n2 - 10n + 3n - 30 = 0

n(n - 10) + 3(n - 10) = 0

(n - 10)(n + 3) = 0

n = 10 or -3

Number of terms cannot be negative.

So n = 10

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
